item.title: How Minolta Launched This $20,000 Camera Decades Ahead of Its Time
item.description: When one talks about DSLRs, only a handful of companies come to mind: Sony, Nikon, and Canon. Although Minolta was also in the game, it faded away over time. But when you look back at their history, you realise that their contribution was critical for the industry, even if it is forgotten today. What does it mean? I am talking about the most ambitious DSLR ever made: Minolta RD-175.

item.title: The 3 Best Canon Cameras for Low Light Photography
item.description: Canon cameras are pretty exceptional in many ways. The SLR models were pretty innovative and ahead of their time, while the mirrorless cameras are now catching up with the technology. One great example is the use of cameras for night photography. With more and more cameras becoming better at low light, here is a look at a few from Canon that continue to be the go-to option for many.

item.title: When the Golden Hour is Useless
item.description: For my entire career, photographers and agencies have told me that shooting during the golden hour is best. And even today, people tell me that that's when we should shoot. But I've always replied with a unique statement: I make my own light. But this isn't necessarily when the golden hour is useless to me. And instead, I think that photographers should keep in mind a powerful tool they're ignoring.

item.title: The 5 Most Important Cameras From OM System
item.description: OM System, formerly known as Olympus, has always been at the forefront of Four Thirds and Micro Four Thirds technology. The company introduced cameras that prove why smaller sensors work better in many situations, and how they can withstand many challenges in a rigid environment. Today, we look back at the five most important technological innovations from the company to prove that they have always thought of photographers first.

item.title: What You Should Know About Zeiss Lenses (In a Nutshell)
item.description: If you've been considering the new Zeiss Otus lenses or even something older, then know that the Phoblographer has reviewed pretty much all of them over the years except for the new Otus glass. And more importantly, we're very aware of all the big differences between them. If you're curious, then we recommend that you check out this very short guide in a nutshell.

item.title: The 5 Important Cameras That Every Fujifilm Users Shot
item.description: Fujifilm cameras are important for many users. The X series is important for serious enthusiasts, while the medium format ups the game for professional photographers. However, the story began a while ago, and today we are looking at the few offerings that changed the way we look at cameras. Have a look.

item.title: Will Canon Launch its Boldest lens This February?
item.description: Canon has introduced some great lenses for the EF mount that photographers still attest to today. Given the current lineup for the RF mount, Canon is still far from the numbers they had launched during the EF days. It now appears that to change this, the company is developing a lens that will cater to creative photographers. Have a look.

item.title: The 5 Most Influential Cameras from Canon
item.description: Canon cameras are pretty exceptional in many ways. The company has introduced devices that remain exceptional in many ways, from colors to build quality to higher megapixels. While there are multiple models that do great, we are looking at a few that truly changed the world of photography.
